Undoable.

tool.branch.reply.nextVersion.note: HI-2807: cw_branch nextVersion. {move} and {stay} are lists ("-" for none); {preview} an id.

tool.console.description.note: #636: offered only with Settings → Agent API → Let agents read the developer console.

tool.createProject.description.text: Create a project: a new folder in the workspace, turned on. Only when the user asked for one.

tool.createTask.arg.kind.assistant.text: no-code: work with no commits (a decision, a write-up), finished by its summary. Default code.

tool.createTask.arg.lane.text: Your lane: your name, or '{ builder, reviewer, position }'.

tool.createTask.description.text: Add a card, in todo unless column says otherwise (never done{role, select, assistant {} other { or hold}}). {role, select, assistant {Give it a project: without one it can't be started on an agent.} other {Your project's only.}} Replies with its key and place.

tool.createTask.reply.notPlaced.note: HI-2167: the card is made; {why} is the Agent API's reason.

tool.declarePaths.description.text: Declare the paths a card's work will change, in a folder shared with other agents. Moves nothing.

tool.inbox.arg.ack.text: Ids you have acted on ("m12"). Alone, it acks and lists nothing.

tool.inbox.arg.read.text: With ack: acks, then reads what is new, in the same call.

tool.inbox.description.text: What Combwork has for you (messages, tasks, the user's decisions, card events), oldest first, with ids. Read, act, then ack what you acted on in your next call, with read=true to read on in it (card events need no ack): one not acked within {minutes} minutes shows as overdue. (detail: use-cw-api, tools.md)
tool.inbox.description.note: #1531: read=true acks and reads in one call.

tool.intent.arg.revision.text: Default: the card's current revision (its commit, or its files' hash). A commit's short id (7+ characters) will do.

tool.journalEntry.description.text: One journal entry in full: its detail, why, links, tags, and what supersedes it or it supersedes.

tool.journalUpdate.description.text: Change a journal entry: its text, importance, supersededBy (a newer entry), links or tags. delete=true deletes it: for what is wrong, or what the user asks you to forget.

tool.journalWrite.arg.linkRef.text: A card key, commit, note path, entry id…

It ends by itself when every card is Done; abandoning it is the user's. (detail: use-cw-api, tools.md)

tool.lane.description.assistant.text: Lanes: a builder and reviewer taking a project's cards in order (card-loop). start (builder, reviewer or pool, cards; brief, given with each card: never prompt it separately), end (abandoned=true: unfinished), list. tool.listProviders.error.unknown.note: cw_list_providers (HI-2814): provider names none; {ids} lists the providers’ ids.

tool.listSettings.arg.project.text: A project's own settings too (its name).

tool.updateTask.arg.answers.text: With decision: the forYou request ids the user's words answer (questions only).

tool.updateTask.arg.before.text: Just above this card, in the column it ends in.

tool.updateTask.arg.blockedBy.text: Cards that have to be done first (replaces the list).

tool.updateTask.arg.confirmKind.text: Answers an agent's no-code proposal: true no-code, false code. As the user says.

tool.updateTask.arg.decision.text: The user's decision in a sentence, recorded as theirs. Never your own choice. Combwork normally tells the card's agent.

tool.updateTask.arg.kind.text: Its kind changed: only with override (the user's reason).

tool.updateTask.arg.position.text: In its column; top is highest priority.

tool.updateTask.arg.review.text: Records your review (reviewing isn't working on it).

tool.updateTask.arg.skipReview.text: The user's reason it skips review, or false to review it after all.

tool.updateTask.arg.title.text: About 70 characters; detail goes in the description.

tool.updateTask.description.text: Change a card of your project and/or comment on it. Moves are the intent tools' (cw_start_card, cw_submit, cw_verdict…): a column here is taken as one, and the reply names it.

tool.updateTask.description.assistant.text: Change a card and/or comment on it. Into doing it starts nothing (cw_start_task does). hold and done are the user's: only when they ask. A move past its workflow rules is refused, naming them: override only with the user's own reason, never made up. (detail: use-cw-api, tools.md)

tool.updateTask.reply.journalNote.note: #1346 item 8: an Assistant with its journal on recorded six decisions and wrote none of them down.

tool.updateTasks.arg.agent.text: Given to each card (empty takes it away).

tool.updateTasks.arg.blocked.text: Why each is blocked (empty clears it).

tool.updateTasks.arg.numbers.text: The cards to change, up to 100.

tool.updateTasks.arg.position.text: The top or bottom of each card's column, in turn.

tool.updateTasks.description.text: Change up to 100 of your project's cards the same way (column, position, blocked, labels, agent), each as cw_update_task would; one it can't change is left. Order cards with cw_reorder_tasks.

tool.updateTasks.description.assistant.text: Change up to 100 cards at once, each the same way (column, position, blocked, labels, agent), each as cw_update_task would; one it can't change is left and the rest change. Order cards with cw_reorder_tasks.

tool.verdict.arg.failKind.text: A fail of the work (content) or only of how it was explained.

tool.verdict.description.text: Give your verdict on the card you review, comment written on it: a pass moves it on, a fail sends it back to Doing for its builder (a round counted).

tool.waitForAgents.arg.timeoutSeconds.text: Without wake: how long it waits here (default 50, at most {max}).

tool.waitForAgents.description.text: Wait until agents stop working (all busy ones if none named). wake=true: an agent watch, your one watch (a card watch replaces it); Combwork types a line here when one finishes. End your turn after it. (detail: use-cw-api, tools.md)

tool.waitForTasks.arg.agents.text: With lanes: agents followed beside them.

tool.waitForTasks.arg.events.text: What a lane watch counts; the default is in tools.md.

tool.waitForTasks.arg.fresh.text: Only the next move into column (a failed card's next round).

tool.waitForTasks.arg.lanes.text: Lane ids, or ["all"] (with wake); cards and agents then follow beside them.

tool.waitForTasks.arg.since.text: Without wake: the last reply's since, so nothing between waits is missed.

tool.waitForTasks.arg.timeoutSeconds.text: Without wake: how long it waits here (default 300, at most {max}).

tool.waitForTasks.arg.usage.text: With wake: also when an account's use reaches percent.

tool.waitForTasks.description.text: Wait for cards to change (changes narrows it), or with column until one is there. wake=true: a card watch; Combwork types a line here when one changes. End your turn after it. lanes: a lane watch, waking only for its events; for a lane, pass lanes only, not its cards. (detail: use-cw-api, tools.md)

tool.writeSharedNote.description.text: Create or overwrite a shared note (.combwork/shared); append=true adds to its end. expectedRevision: written only if unchanged since you read it. "Workspace notes.md" is the user's and the Assistant's to write.
